messages:
cheng: Ran the surge-simulation job for EU/US/APAC at 18:00 UTC — attaching short summary below. Notable: APAC spot shortfall ~12% for P4d class when we simulated 3x request rate spike, latency p95 increased ~120ms.

mira: Can you paste the sim outputs? curious about queue depth vs prewarm behavior.

ops-bot: Simulation run 6123456789 complete. Summary artifact: https://artifacts.internal/sim/6123456789/results.csv :white_check_mark:

cheng: Pasted snippet:```region,instance_class,shortfall_pct,p95_latency_ms
EU,p4d,2,78
US,p4d,1,85
APAC,p4d,12,205
APAC,g4dn,0,90```

ton y: @mira re: APAC quota — current cloud provider soft limit is 48 P4d per region, we hit 42 in the sim. We can request bump but SOC needs justification. I can open the request.

mira: OK. If bump will take days, let's plan a fallback: model-quantized variant on g4dn for non-critical traffic and keep P4d for heavy tails. Also consider prefix cache warming for common prompts.

sam: I can wire the prewarm lambda to push warm keys into KV cache. Need PR for infra role changes (will post shortly).

lina: blocker: finance flagged extra reserved instances on that account last quarter; we shouldn't ask for persistent capacity increases without signoff. Might be able to approve temporary surge (<72h) but need cost estimate.

cheng: Good catch. Action items: (1) @tony open quota ticket and mark as temporary surge request + cost estimate, (2) @sam prepare prewarm PR and short runbook for fallback to g4dn quantized variant, (3) @mira draft perf target for p95 reduction goal and list priority endpoints. I'll assign follow-ups in the ticket.

tony: Opening ticket now: CLOUD-REQ-8421 — adding sim output and cost delta for 72h surge. ETA for provider response usually 48-72h.

ops-bot: CLOUD-REQ-8421 created by tony at 6123456798. Status: open.

sam: Starting on PR branch `infra/prewarm-apac-6123`, will ping for review. Also adding simple smoke test script:```# smoke prewarm
curl -X POST https://redwood/api/v1/prewarm -d '{"region":"apac","model":"q4_g4dn"}'```

lina: If ticket asks for cost delta, budgetary number: ~$9k for 72h at projected peak — include that.

mira: I'll post the perf targets and endpoints in the ticket this afternoon. If provider approves surge, we'll run a short canary: 10% traffic to P4d, 90% to fallback for 2 hours, monitor error rate and p95.

cheng: Thanks team. I'll follow up tomorrow morning with an updated rollout plan. :thumbsup:

mira: Thanks — adding to daily ops checklist. :eyes:
